provenance: Original SVG geometry in the accepted Fomo vector system; no copied art, embedded raster, external resources, logos or runtime fonts.

structural_references.use: Instrument educator/player describes small pear-shaped box, long tied-fret neck and four strings. Original drawing, no traced imagery.
Smithsonian reference corroborates four-string setar, wood soundbox and movable twine frets.
Three-bladed horizontal-axis rotor and tubular tower.
Two ropes turned in eggbeater fashion; final original scene includes two turners and central jumper.

issues.observation: v1 lone jumper inside two arcs resembled a hoop; rope turners were missing.
issues.revision: Added two turners visibly gripping both rope ends and lifted jumper clear of the lower rope.

limitations: Three-person arrangement and two colored rope paths remain distinguishable at 24/32px.
